10k.note: 10-K describes a noninvasive patient-monitoring device business (SET pulse oximetry, rainbow SET, regional oximetry, capnography, brain monitoring, hospital automation). No proprietary therapeutic drug pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public drug-pipeline page; masimo.com is product-marketing focused on monitoring devices and Hospital Automation platforms

ctgov.note: The single returned trial (NCT06644573) is investigator-led (lead sponsor: Nyree Penn / PROSOMNIA Sleep Health & Wellness); Masimo is only a collaborator providing the SedLine EEG monitoring device. Not a Masimo-owned drug or device pivotal.

commercial_product.note: Manufacturer of noninvasive patient-monitoring technologies. Marketed devices include Masimo SET pulse oximetry, rainbow SET (SpHb, SpCO, SpMet, PVi), Root patient monitoring/connectivity hub, Radius PPG / Radius VSM wearable monitoring, SedLine brain function (EEG) monitoring, O3 regional oximetry (rSO2), NomoLine capnography, Centroid posture/orientation sensor, Bridge opioid-withdrawal device, Stork home baby monitor, and Iris hospital-automation / patient-care platforms. FDA-cleared via 510(k) and de novo pathways.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated PROSOMNIA sleep therapy study; Masimo is collaborator (SedLine EEG monitor used for measurement) — not a Masimo-led pivotal.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Masimo is a noninvasive patient-monitoring device company. It develops monitoring sensors and software (pulse oximetry, brain function, capnography, hospital automation) regulated as medical devices, not pharmaceuticals. ClinicalTrials.gov shows no active company-sponsored P1-P3 interventional pivotal of a Masimo-owned investigational drug or device.
